slides.title: Projections in Ranges
slides.prompt: What is a projection in C++20 std::ranges algorithms?
options: A callable function that transforms elements before applying the primary algorithm/predicate
A view that filters out null pointers
A method to print range content to screen
A thread execution model for ranges
slides.correctAnswer: A callable function that transforms elements before applying the primary algorithm/predicate

slides.title: Range Views Evaluation
slides.prompt: How are range views evaluated in C++20 range pipelines?
options: Lazily evaluated on-demand as elements are iterated over
Eagerly computed immediately creating temporary container copies
Evaluated in parallel across multiple worker threads
Compiled directly into static array constants
slides.correctAnswer: Lazily evaluated on-demand as elements are iterated over

slides.title: std::views::take Functionality
options: Creates a view containing at most the first N elements of range v
Removes the first N elements from container v
Splits container v into chunks of size N
Skips N elements and returns the remainder
slides.correctAnswer: Creates a view containing at most the first N elements of range v
